configuration.maximumVisibleDirectoryEnt: Maximum number of direct children rendered at once. Local filesystem and Linux Remote-SSH listings stop after this page plus one look-ahead entry; other virtual providers may fall back to VS Code enumeration.
walkthrough.title: Start Safe Remote Browsing
walkthrough.description: Browse a large Remote-SSH directory without opening it as a VS Code workspace.
walkthrough.step.openView.title: Keep the large directory out of the workspace
walkthrough.step.openView.description: Connect with Remote-SSH and leave the large directory unopened. Open the [Explorer](command:workbench.view.explorer), then find **Lazy Workspace Guard**.
walkthrough.step.openView.altText: A protected folder for on-demand browsing
walkthrough.step.browse.title: Add a safe remote root
walkthrough.step.browse.description: In an empty Remote-SSH window, run [Browse Remote Directory Safely](command:lazyWorkspaceGuard.browseRemoteDirectory), enter an absolute path, select a completion if useful, then choose **Browse**.
walkthrough.step.browse.altText: A protected folder with a remote directory path
walkthrough.step.safety.title: Understand the safety boundary
walkthrough.step.safety.description: Expand only the folders you need. Removing a safe root only removes its saved entry; **Delete** changes the remote filesystem. [Refresh diagnostics](command:lazyWorkspaceGuard.refreshDiagnostics) to view bounded-read metrics.
walkthrough.step.safety.altText: A folder protected by a shield
